content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
wunɛ tɔnun bii, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ ye nɑ ɡerumɔ bɛɛ Isirelibɑn sɔ̃. Nɑ nɛɛ, kpeerɑ wee. Tɑ pusi bɛɛn tem ɡoonu nnɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Tɛ̃ tɑ koo bɛɛ deemɑ. Kon de nɛn mɔru yu bɛɛ wɔri. Kon bɛɛ siriwɑ nɡe mɛ bɛɛn sɑnu sɑnusu sɑ̃ɑ. Kpɑ n bɛɛ kɔ̃sɑ ye i kuɑ kpuron ɑre kɔsie.
Nɑ ǹ bɛɛ mɛɛrimɔ kɑ wɔnwɔndu. Nɑ̀ n bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ, nɑ ǹ tii nɛnumɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ ye i kuɑ yerɑ kon bɛɛ kɔsiɑ. Kpɑ i ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Amɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, kɔ̃sɑ wee, yɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ ɡɑɑ weenɛ.
Kpeerɑ wee, kpeerɑ wee. Wee tɑ seemɔ tɑ wee bɛɛn mi. Wee tɑ sisi.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, sɑɑ yɑ turuku kuɑ. Tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ turuku kuɑ, tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑhɑlɑn tɔ̃ru. Tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔ, nuku dobun kuuki kun mɑɑ nɔɔrɑmɔ ɡuunu wɔllɔ.
Tɛ̃ kon de nɛn mɔru yu se. Nɑ ǹ ye yɔ̃rɑsiɑmɔ mɑ n kun mɔ yɑ kɑ tii sɑrɑ. Kon bɛɛ siriwɑ nɡe mɛ bɛɛn dɑɑ yɑ nɛ.
Nɑ ǹ bɛɛ mɛɛrimɔ kɑ wɔnwɔndu. Nɑ̀ n bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ tii nɛnumɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ ye i kuɑ yerɑ kon bɛɛ kɔsie kpɑ i ɡiɑ mɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Tɔ̃ɔ te wee tɑ tunumɑ, tɑ turuku kuɑ. Bɔbunu kɑ tii suɑbu bu sosimɔ.
Bɔbunu nu kuɑ nɡe dɛkɑ ye bɑ rɑ kɑ tɔmbu so. Gɑ̃ɑnu kun mɑɑ bɛɛ tiɑmmɛ. Tɔn dɑbiru tɑ koo ɡbi. Bɑɑ wɔkinu kun mɑɑ nɔɔrɑmɔ. Goo kun mɑɑ weeweenu mɔ̀ bɛɛn sɔ̃.
Sɑɑ yɑ turuku mɔ̀. Tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ wee. Wi u dwemɔ u ku yɛ̃ɛri. Wi u mɑɑ dɔrɑmɔ u ku swĩ. Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru sisi tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ kpuron sɔ̃.
Wi u dɔrɑ u ǹ mɑɑ ye u dɔrɑ wɑsi u mwɑ bɑɑ ù n wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ. Domi ɡɑri yi bɑ ɡeruɑ tɔn be kpuron sɔ̃, yi koo koorɑ. Goo sɑri wi u koo yɑkiɑrɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑɑwure u wɑ̃ɑ kom bɛrɛtɛkɛ sɔɔ.
Wee bɑ kɔbɑ so bɑ sɔɔru kpɑ. Adɑmɑ ben ɡoo kun tɑbu seemɔ, domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru seewɑ be tɔn dɑbi ten sɔ̃.
Goo sɑri
wi u koo sɛɛyɑsiɑbu kisirɑri
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɑbu ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ swɛɛ sɔɔ kpɑ bɑrɑnu kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔnu nu n wɑ̃ɑ yɛnusɔ. Tɔmbu bɑ koo ɡbi tɑbu sɔɔ yɑkɑsɔ. Be bɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu sɔɔ bɑ koo ɡbiwɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru kɑ bɑrɑnun sɔ̃.
Be bɑ mɑɑ kisirɑ bɑ koo kpikiru dɑwɑ ɡuunu wɔllɔ nɡe kpɑrukonu kpɑ bu weeweenu ko ben torɑnun sɔ̃.

content.text: Ben nɔmɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑre dɑm sɑrirun sɔ̃.
Kpɑ ben dũɑ yu diiri.
Bɑ koo sɑɑki sebewɑ kpɑ bu ben seri kɔni nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Bɑ koo nɑndɑ kpɑ sekuru bu mwɑ.
Bɑ koo ɡobi kɔ̃ swɛɛ sɔɔ,
kpɑ bu ben wurɑbɑ ɡɑrisi nɡe kubɑnu,
domi sii ɡeesu ǹ kun mɛ wurɑ
yen ɡɑɑ kun kpɛ̃ yu bu fɑɑbɑ ko Gusunɔn mɔrun tɔ̃ru sɔɔ.
Bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑsi ye yɑ koo bu debu,
ǹ kun mɛ ye yɑ koo ben binɛ kpunɑsiɑ,
domi sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ yerɑ yɑ derɑ bɑ torɑ.
Bɑ tii suɑ ben wurɑn sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ kɑ ye bwɑ̃ɑroku bɑkɑnu kuɑ ni nu nɑnum mɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kon de bu ye tusi.
Kon de tɔn tukobu bu ben dukiɑ ye ɡurɑ,
kpɑ be bɑ ǹ Gusunɔn bɛɛrɛ yɛ̃ bu ye tubi di bu ye kpuro disi doke.
Nɑ ǹ kɑ bɛɛ yinɑmɔ
sɑnɑm mɛ ɡbɛnɔbu bɑ koo nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dukiɑ disi doke bu ɡurɑ.
A yɔni sɔɔru koowo domi tem mɛ, mu tɔn ɡowobu yibɑwɑ.
Mɛyɑ bɛɛn wuu ɡe, ɡɑ tɔmbu yibɑ be bɑ dɑɑ bɔɔbɔyɑ mɔ.
Kon bwesenu sokumɑ ni nu nuku kɔ̃suru bo,
kpɑ nu bɛɛn yɛnusu mwɛɛri.
Kon bɛɛn dɑmɡibun tii suɑbu kpeesiɑ.
Kpɑ n de bu bɛɛn sɑ̃ɑ yenu disi doke.
Kɑm kobu wee.
I ko i fɑɑbɑ kɑsu, ɑdɑmɑ i ǹ wɑsi.
Kɔ̃sɑ yɑ koo sosi kɔ̃sɑ sɔɔ.
Mɛyɑ lɑbɑɑri kɔ̃si yi ko yi n nɔɔrɑmɔ yi n dɔɔ.
I ko i Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu bikiɑ bu kɑ̃siru kɑsu kpɑ bu bɛɛ sɔ̃ ye yɑ koo nɑ.
Adɑmɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ ǹ ko n Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑ yɛ̃.
Bɛɛn ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ bwisi ɡɛɛ mɔ bu tɔnu kɛ̃.
Bɛɛn sinɑ boko u koo ɡɔɔ sinɑ
kpɑ sinɑ bibu bɑ n wurure.
Tɔmbu kpuro bɑ ko n diirimɔ.
Kon bu kuɑwɑ nɡe mɛ ben kookoosu nɛ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.

content: Bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
